name: Suprajit Engg.
why: Record quarterly sales, annual sales, annual profit
Latest concall: management tone confident / positive
Management outlook: And new prices are now in effect, and we expect a recovery going forward in Q2, Q3.
Latest quarter Jun 2026: Good (sales +24% YoY, profit +8% YoY)
Cost quality excellent: costs falling, margin expanding, operating profit growing (costs 90% to 88% of sales)
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 135% of 3-year profit
risks: Working capital stretching - debtor days 65 to 68, inventory days 123 to 134 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

guidance: And new prices are now in effect, and we expect a recovery going forward in Q2, Q3.
The guidance we gave, I mean, despite all these things, the guidance that we gave in our press release dated 25th May 2026, still holds for the year.
risks: Stand- alone margins came under pressure, and Mohan will be walking through that as to what happened and how it's going to be a temporary phenomenon for us.
First things, I think we need to recognize that we have strong headwinds that has hit us not in terms of the market itself, market is doing good, but the raw material prices are really gone sky high.
focus: I'm not talking specifically of the numbers, but just more qualitative comment that how the new products are really contributing in ensuring that the growth rate is now matching with the sector growth rates?
And when I say new order wins, either an addition of a product or addition of a model or a new customer or a new geography, et cetera, et cetera.
But what our business development guys are doing now is that we are pitching in some of our new products, particularly from the STC products on the displays and on sensors, et cetera.
